messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a ~3x jump in console trace storage cost this morning vs yesterday. Dashboard shows much higher ingested span count but sampling rate in the UI still says 10%. Anyone changed sampling or are we double-ingesting? :eyes:
ajay: I pushed a change to trace hook last week but it only toggles the new header. Didn't touch sampling. Are you seeing duplicate span IDs or just count increase?
kevin: From infra side we did flip the retention-tier for the eu-cluster yesterday (lower TTL -> more hot storage). That could increase cost if more traces are retained in hot tier. Not changing sample rate.
olga: SRE — added a short-lived drain to move traces during the eu rollout. Might have caused overlapping writes for ~10m around 06:12 UTC. Will check logs.
maria: I pulled a small sample and saw contiguous span ids repeating for some requests, looks like duplicates. Query I ran:```sql
select span_id, count(*) from traces_raw where ts > now() - interval '1 hour' group by span_id order by count desc limit 5;```
ajay: Hmm that query would show duplicates. I can instrument the hook to add a debug tag to new headers and redeploy to canary. If duplicates are from the drain it's infra/ops overlap though.
sylvia: tagging in from dashboard team — the ingestion metric pipeline uses the raw count from traces_raw. If duplicates exist it will overcount and the dashboard won't reflect sample_rate. We should either dedupe at ingestion or show `unique_spans` metric.
maria: Agreed. Short-term: can we surface unique span count as a new metric? Long-term: avoid duplicate writes.
kevin: I can roll back the drain window config and re-run the move during low traffic. Rolling back now would take ~8m. Approve?
olga: Go for it, but I'll tail the move logs and alert if anything spikes.
ajay: I'll push a tiny instrumentation to add `hook_version=dedupe-check` tag to the span and deploy to canary (10% traffic) in 5m. If duplicates persist in canary we'll have proof it's upstream.
maria: Thanks. Can you post the canary trace IDs when up? I'll correlate with dashboard and cost numbers.
deploy-bot: deploy started by ajay — service: trace-hook, version: canary-dedupe-check, traffic: 10% — 2331235120
ajay: Deployed. pinging once canary collects ~200 traces.
sylvia: I'll add a `unique_spans` sparkline to the trace ingestion card so product sees both counts. ETA: 2 hours for a quick panel, or we can add a temp alert on discrepancy ratio > 1.3.
maria: Temp alert sounds good. Who owns the alert?
sylvia: Dashboard team will own the alert creation, but on-call SRE (olga) handles firing actions.
olga: On it. I'll add an ops-runbook note to check for duplicate span ids and retention tier changes.
kevin: After rollback and canary we can re-schedule the eu move to 02:00 UTC and run with stricter drain window. I'll add that to infra change PR.
ajay: Canary shows much lower duplicates with dedupe tag — initial correlation suggests drain overlap caused most duplicates. I'll keep the canary running for 30m and then promote.
maria: That's great. Please paste a few example trace IDs here when you have them, and sylvia please set the temp alert.
ajay: Example trace ids (canary): trace_0a1b2c, trace_3d4e5f, trace_9a8b7c
sylvia: Created alert `trace_ingest_discrepancy_v2` -> fires when raw_count / unique_spans > 1.25 over 5m. Dashboard panel added to staging.
olga: Noted in runbook: check retention-tier flips, draining overlap, hook versions. Tagging owners: infra@, eng-platform@.
maria: Thanks all — follow-ups: kevin to schedule eu move at 02:00 UTC, ajay to promote dedupe patch if canary stays clean, sylvia to enable alert in prod, olga to monitor runbook actions. I'll post a short summary to #product once prod alert is in. :thumbsup:
